presentation.label: SKULL
presentation.summary: A shaded 3D skull that reacts to your playing: the jaw opens, the eyes light, it jolts on attacks and explodes at the loudest. Passes the sound through.
presentation.overview: A shaded 3D skull that reacts to your playing: the jaw opens, the eyes light, it jolts on attacks and explodes at the loudest. Passes the sound through.
highlights: Compare quiet notes and loud attacks. Watch the jaw, shake and burst while the audio passes through.
usage: Add Skull from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Compare quiet notes and loud attacks. Watch the jaw, shake and burst while the audio passes through.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Skull.

controls.name: Sense
controls.doc: How much signal it takes to open the jaw. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Decay
controls.doc: How fast the face relaxes after a note. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Shake
controls.doc: How hard the skull jolts on attacks (0 = never). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Boom
controls.doc: At the very loudest the skull explodes and re-forms. 0 = never; higher = easier to set off. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
